messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-promo to release/2026-07-15 paused: ci-staging failed during artifact restore (cache restore checksum mismatch). Holding promotion. https://ci.internal/runs/17661

river: which package and checksum?

deploy-bot: Artifact: redwood-llm-runtime-3.2.0.whl expected sha256=fc9a7d2b got=aa77b33c
sana: tail of fetch log:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood-llm-runtime-3.2.0.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=fc9a7d2b... actual=aa77b33c...
storage read returned truncated object
```

infra-bot: mirror-sync reported multipart finalize errors for prefix redwood-llm-runtime/3.2.0 at 11:14 UTC

sre-matt: change window closes in ~22m. Options: 1) reupload mirror now and retry (uncertain) 2) pin to last-known-good digest and promote, then rebuild and reupload later. Thoughts?

pm-olivia: customers expect the release. I'd lean pin+promote to avoid slipping the changelog and docs schedule.

river: found last-good digest: s3://prod-mirror/redwood-llm-runtime/3.2.0/sha256.txt -> fc9a7d2b. Also archived artifact at longterm://artifacts/fc9a7d2b.whl

sre-matt: if we pin, create incident INC-2026-307, add rollback steps (how to unpin), and run quick wheel-inspect and smoke eval post-promo.

sana: running dry-run pin:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2026-07-15 --artifact redwood-llm-runtime==3.2.0 --digest fc9a7d2b --force-pin --dry-run
```

sana: dry-run output OK, manifest and signature checks pass. Proceeding with real promote.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest fc9a7d2b. Auto-promo resumed. Promotion complete.

pm-olivia: updated release notes: "redwood-llm-runtime 3.2.0 pinned to verified digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; rebuild and mirror reupload scheduled."
river: created INC-2026-307 and assigned to infra-blobstore. Will follow up with uploader logs and multipart finalize trace.
sre-matt: marking thread resolved for release. Incident remains open for RCA and uploader fix."
